mapper.insert: INSERT INTO chat_messages (project_id, sender_id, content, type) VALUES (#{projectId}, #{senderId}, #{content}, #{type})
mapper.select: SELECT cm.id AS message_id, cm.project_id, cm.sender_id, u.name AS sender_name, u.profile_image_url AS sender_profile_image_url, cm.content, cm.type, cm.created_at FROM chat_messages cm JOIN users u ON u.id = cm.sender_id WHERE cm.id = #{messageId}
